name: Meta Tags
description_en:
Meta Tags is a browser utility for drafting a page’s metadata and comparing search/social preview layouts. The visible workspace contains URL parsing, image, title and description controls; its default Get Code panel shows primary, Open Graph and X card markup for copying into a website. The generated panel also reminds the user to host the image.

It fits a small editorial handoff: prepare a page-specific title, summary and share image, inspect the layout, then implement and verify metadata in the destination CMS. Google’s title and snippet systems can choose other text, so the mock preview is not a promise about a live search result. This profile uses the public default example, current primary search/protocol documentation and the published privacy policy. No custom URL was parsed, image uploaded, code deployed or platform result tested.
description_zh:
Meta Tags 是浏览器元数据起草及搜索／社交布局比较工具。可见工作区有 URL 解析、图片、标题及描述控件，默认 Get Code 面板显示供复制到网站的基础、Open Graph 及 X card 标记，并提醒需托管图片。

适合小型编辑交付：准备逐页标题、摘要及分享图，审布局，再到目标 CMS 实现及核元数据。Google 标题／摘要系统可选其他文字，模拟预览不是实时搜索结果承诺。本条用公开默认示例、当前搜索／协议原文及隐私政策，未解析自定义 URL、上传图、部署代码或测试平台结果。

sections.title_en: Begin with one page’s promise, not a generic site slogan
sections.title_zh: 先写单页承诺，而非通用网站口号
sections.en: The public editor presents title, description and image controls beside preview cards. Editorial first draft: identify the intended page and write a short promise that its content actually fulfills; check whether the image remains understandable in a small card. Compare the layouts before handing the values to the CMS editor. This inspection used the existing public example only. It did not test URL parsing, multilingual character counts, crop behavior, error handling or the accuracy of a submitted page’s extraction.
sections.zh: 公开编辑器在预览卡旁提供标题、描述及图片。编辑首稿：明确目标页、写内容能实现的简短承诺，审图片缩卡后是否可懂。交 CMS 编辑前比布局。本次仅检查现有公开示例，未测 URL 解析、多语字符计数、裁剪、错误处理或提交页提取准确性。

sections.title_en: Generating markup is separate from changing a website
sections.title_zh: 生成标记与改网站是独立步骤
sections.en: Get Code opens a panel containing title/description, Open Graph properties and a summary_large_image X card in the default example. It instructs the user to place the code in the website head and separately host the image. Editorial handoff: map the desired values to the CMS’s existing fields and inspect the resulting head after saving. Do not assume the utility has published anything to the destination. Duplicating a CMS’s existing metadata is an implementation question to resolve in that CMS, not a feature that this public example verified.
sections.zh: 默认示例 Get Code 打开含标题／描述、Open Graph 及 summary_large_image X card 的面板，提示放网站 head 并独立托管图片。编辑交付：将目标值映到 CMS 现有字段，保存后审所得 head。不能假定工具已向目标发布。重复 CMS 已有元数据需在该 CMS 解决，公开示例未验证此能力。

sections.title_en: An Open Graph image is a URL-backed resource
sections.title_zh: Open Graph 图片是 URL 指向资源
sections.en: The Open Graph protocol defines title, type, image and canonical object URL as its basic required properties. Image width, height and alternative text are structured properties; the image entry points to a resource rather than embedding the selected picture in a tag. Editorial asset check: use the intended final image URL, verify it belongs to the correct page and review meaningful alternative text where implemented. The utility’s 1200×628 recommendation is a product preset, not a protocol-wide guarantee that every platform will render the same crop or layout. Actual image delivery was not tested.
sections.zh: Open Graph 将标题、类型、图片及规范对象 URL 定为基础必需属性；宽高及替代文字为结构化属性。图片项指资源，不把所选图嵌进标签。编辑资产核查：用最终图 URL、核匹配页面，已实现时审有意义替代文字。工具 1200×628 建议是产品预设，不保证全部平台相同裁剪／布局，未测真实图片交付。

sections.title_en: The displayed character count is not a Google title limit
sections.title_zh: 显示字符数不是 Google 标题上限
sections.en: The site’s explanatory copy gives a fixed title-length rule. Current Google documentation instead says title elements have no length limit; displayed title links may be truncated to device width and are generated from several sources, including headings and Open Graph title. Changes require recrawling/reprocessing. Editorial title review: prefer an accurate, concise, page-specific title and consistency with the main content over merely reaching a counter value. A good-looking mock title does not require Google to display that exact text or prove the page is indexed.
sections.zh: 站点解释文给固定标题长度。当前 Google 文档却称 title 无长度上限，显示标题可按设备宽截断，并从标题、Open Graph 等多来源生成，更新需重抓／处理。编辑标题：优先准确简洁、逐页且与正文一致，不只凑计数。模拟标题好看不要求 Google 原样显示，也不证明已收录。

sections.title_en: One saved description can produce different search snippets
sections.title_zh: 一个保存描述可对应不同搜索摘要
sections.en: Google primarily generates snippets from page content, sometimes using the meta description when it better summarizes the page. The snippet can differ by query, and there is no fixed meta-description length limit; display truncation typically fits device width. Editorial description: summarize what this page offers in natural language and inspect the actual result for relevant queries after publication. The utility’s fixed-length advice and its mock card do not establish the final snippet. A CMS edit can be correct even when Google selects a different passage for one search.
sections.zh: Google 主要用正文生成摘要，描述更合适时才使用；可随查询变，meta description 无固定长度上限，显示通常按设备宽截断。编辑描述：自然概括本页提供什么，发布后审相关查询真实结果。工具固定长度建议及模拟卡不确定最终摘要，Google 某次选其他段落时 CMS 修改仍可能正确。

sections.title_en: A local mock and a platform debugger answer different questions
sections.title_zh: 本地模拟与平台调试器回答不同问题
sections.en: The workspace links to Facebook, X, LinkedIn and structured-data inspectors. These are external destinations, not evidence of a native publishing integration or a completed validation. Editorial release sequence: preserve the selected text/image, implement it through the destination’s normal editor, read back its public metadata and then use the applicable platform’s own inspection tools. Investigate any difference at the layer that produced it. Changing the tool’s preview alone is not evidence that a platform fetched the updated page; no external debugger submission was performed here.
sections.zh: 工作区链接 Facebook、X、LinkedIn 及结构化数据检查器，是外部目标，不证明原生发布集成或已完成验证。编辑发布顺序：保所选文字／图、经目标正常编辑器实现、读回公开元数据，再用适用平台检查工具。在产生差异的层调查。只改预览不证明平台已取更新页，此处未提交任何外部调试器。

sections.title_en: A public utility is not established as a private offline editor
sections.title_zh: 公开工具未确定为私有离线编辑器
sections.en: The privacy policy describes submitted information, technical/log data, cookies, analytics and service-provider sharing. It also discusses generic accounts/APIs and says post-account information may remain for at least three years, without a specific metadata/image deletion workflow. Those policy references do not establish that the visible utility currently offers an account or public API. Editorial evaluation: use public page material and confirm actual processing/retention requirements before a private draft or signed URL is submitted. This research did not verify client-only processing, storage location, upload expiry, plan limits, pricing, source-code license or team access.
sections.zh: 隐私政策描述提交信息、技术／日志、Cookie、分析及服务方共享，还谈通用账户／API，称账户后信息可至少保三年，但未给元数据／图片具体删除流程。这些引用不确定可见工具当前提供账户或公开 API。编辑评估：用公开页面材料，提交私稿或签名 URL 前确认真实处理／保留要求。本研究未核纯客户端处理、存储位置、上传过期、套餐限额、价格、源码许可或团队访问。
